svg.title: Governance ledger archive
svg.desc: Context-of-use ledger records shown as an archive. A wave passes, one record is drawn out and opens: its sequence, change, configuration version and release disposition. Every record stays blocked pending evidence; none carries an approval.

g.text: v52 release refresh adopted as the first
All 26 frozen whole records stay exact.

svg.text: Matching hashes prove software identity only. No record claims scientific validation, review or clinical qualification.
